text: dsh-archived-sessions 是一个面向 DSH Web 客户端的会话管理插件，会在设置中加入“归档会话”页面。页面读取归档会话列表及其标题、工作区和更新时间，按更新时间展示条目，并支持按标题或工作区搜索。用户可从条目旁点击恢复，将会话放回工作区；恢复过程中会显示忙碌状态，失败时呈现错误信息。界面支持中文和英文，并使用宿主界面主题变量。适合需要查找并重新打开已归档会话的 DSH 用户；需要 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 或更高版本，不需要额外密钥。

dsh-archived-sessions adds an Archived Sessions page to DSH web Settings. Browse archived conversations by title, workspace, and update time; search by title or workspace. Restore one to its workspace, with progress and errors shown. Bilingual interface; requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 or newer.
我想找回之前从侧边栏移走的会话。
能按标题或工作区搜索归档记录吗？
I need to restore an archived conversation to its workspace.
dsh-archived-sessions 的功能「搜索归档会话」：设置页列出归档会话标题、所属工作区和更新时间，按更新时间排序。用户在搜索框输入文字后，可按标题或工作区名称筛选结果。
dsh-archived-sessions 的功能「恢复会话」：用户在归档列表中点击某条记录的恢复按钮，即调用 DSH 工作区服务取消归档并将会话放回原工作区；操作期间按钮显示处理中，失败时页面展示错误。

dsh-archived-sessions README · dsh-archived-sessions：**Browse archived conversations and restore them to the sidebar from Settings.**

A small DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds an **Archived Sessions** page under Settings. It lists every archived conversation with its workspace and last-updated time, supports searching, and restores a conversation to its original workspace in one click.

dsh-archived-sessions README · Features：- Lists archived conversations with title, workspace, and last update
- Search by conversation title or workspace
- One-click **Restore** puts the conversation back in its original workspace
- Live updates from the workspace archive stream
- Follows the host theme and UI language (English / 中文)
- No message content is read; the page only uses session metadata

> Archived conversations cannot be opened directly in Harness. Restore one first, then open it from the sidebar.

dsh-archived-sessions README · Install：From GitHub:

```sh
dsh plugin add github:sy297/dsh-archived-sessions
```

Or install the prebuilt tarball:

```sh
dsh plugin add https://github.com/sy297/dsh-archived-sessions/releases/latest/download/dsh-archived-sessions.tgz
```

Open **Settings → Archived Sessions** after installation. On some hosts a page refresh is needed after the first install.

dsh-archived-sessions README · Compatibility：- Requires DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.2` or newer (the `settings.section` slot and workspace archive stream)
- Plain JavaScript; no build step or native dependencies

dsh-archived-sessions README · 中文说明：在 **设置 → 归档会话** 中查看已归档的会话。支持按标题/工作区搜索，点「恢复」即可将会话放回原来的工作区。归档会话在 Harness 中本身不能直接打开，恢复后从侧边栏打开即可。

安装：

```sh
dsh plugin add github:sy297/dsh-archived-sessions
```
